findings.text: the baseline_suite/after_suite fields record an arm over tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py and tests/test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py, which import neither reckon/crew/merge.py nor reckon/crew/obligations.py (they name obligations.py only as static census data), so the structured arm fields describe a different arm than the done_when's arm over files that import the change; the 148-file importer arm that does cover it (93 failed at base, 92 at head, no id added) appears only in the artifacts line.

orientation_base_sha states 8277191059 but the node's own work descends from 5c4ff34929, the fast-forward merge of origin/main the done_when ordered (git reflog HEAD@{4}); the commits line omits that merge, so a reader diffing the stated base against the head sees docs/plans/the-monitor-reads-each-fact-once.html and a review record with nothing in the manifest saying they arrived from origin/main.
